subject: general
question:
Refer to the given number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 2 7 & 3 Ω 9 # 1 * £ & % 4 6 @ 8 $ 5 (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series, which of the following will be fifth from the right?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 2 7 & 3 Ω 9 # 1 * £ & % 4 6 @ 8 $ 5 (Right)

Condition: **all the symbols are dropped from the series, fifth from the right.**

Now, 

 (Left) 2 7 3 9 __**1**__ 4 6 8 5 (Right)

Thus, 1 is the fifth from the right after rearrangement of the series.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
